evidence.snippet: …94 Yeltsin Signs European Union Agreement LD2406085994 Moscow ITAR-TASS World Service in Russian 0815 GMT 24 Jun 94 [By ITAR-TASS special correspondents Yuriy Sizov, Vladimir Malyshev, and Yuriy Malinin] [Text] Kerkira (Corfu), 24 Jun—A full-scale document comprising over 80 pages and translated into the 12 [as received] languages of the EU [European Union] mem- ber-countries has not yet been circulated in the press center in Kerkira.
